content.text: {"headline":"Approve P1: lend 2 cross-skilled payments agents to general and switch on IVR callback for general, 19:00–20:00. No extra cost.","why":"Agents on general dropped suddenly at 17:00 to 25 against 32 planned, then 23 against 32 at 17:15. The attendance log doesn't explain it: 3 sick calls against a usual 2.4, the last logged at 14:57. No incident or campaign accounts for it either. Volume and handle time are on forecast, and service level is still 100%. Even with no action, the 17:30–19:30 window is predicted at 94.5% against the 80% target. P1 is the cheapest plan that meets the target and follows policy. It is predicted at 94.7% overall (general 90.6%, payments 98.3%) with 1.1% abandons, at ₹0. Separately, ask floor leads now about unlogged breaks, meetings, training or early leavers, because the cause of the drop is still unknown.","trade_offs":["P1's gain over doing nothing is small: 94.7% vs 94.5% in the window. Its rest-of-day figure is slightly lower, at 93.2% vs 93.4%.","P2 costs ₹36 and does a little better: 95.1% in the window, general 91.5%, abandons 0.9%, rest of day 93.8%.","P3 also costs ₹36 and gives the most protection: 95.6% in the window, general 92.6%, rest of day 95.1%. It needs more moving parts, including delayed general breaks 19:00–19:30 and 3 agents lent from payments.","Payments is not hurt under any plan. It stays at 98.0–98.3% in the window."],"watch":"Track general's staffed agents against plan, and its service level, each interval. If the gap widens beyond 23 vs 32, or general falls toward 80%, consider P2 or P3 (₹36). Confirm the reason for the 17:00 drop with floor leads."}
